listing.name: SF-Ship-ED
listing.summary: The source has been updated to work with the newest BlitzMax Compilers
listing.aiSummary: Provides a ship and weapon editor with features like station/multipart vessel mode, screenshot mode, and damage mode.

description:
The source has been updated to work with the newest BlitzMax Compilers

Some of the bigger added features:

-Station/Multipart Vessel Mode
-Screenshot Mode
-Multi Mod de/activatior
-Linux installation Path support
-Damage Mode
-browse loaded mod files in most modes

aiDescription: Offers a comprehensive tool for editing ships, weapons, and variants. Includes support for CSV editing, projectile editing, skinning, and raw file manipulation. Runs on Windows, Wine/Linux, and native Linux.
